collection.description: A family wants to remove a hive near its fruit trees.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A family wants to remove a hive near its fruit trees.

choices.label: Leave it and change the footpath.
Ask a naturalist to observe first.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The family feels safer, and pollinators continue visiting.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The hive does not survive the move.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: People and insects coexist at a distance.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A frightened child refuses to enter the orchard.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Other pollinators take their place, complicating the lesson.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villagers learn when the insects are least active.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The observations reveal no simple solution.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The immediate worry ends, but fewer flowers set fruit.

c1__text.name: Outcome C1
c1__text.text: The immediate worry ends, but fewer flowers set fruit.
